title: Are we a match?
subtitle: A two-minute self-test for founders of AI companies in regulated sectors. Five questions about fit, then one for each dimension of the 6Sense Filter.
intro_heading: A straight first answer, before the conversation
intro_body:
Attolloo works with a small number of AI companies, and only where it can make a real difference. That means saying no early when the fit is not there.

This self-test follows the same logic as the 6Sense Filter. It is an indication based on your own answers, not the screening itself. The real screening is part of a Readiness Assessment.
privacy_note: Your answers stay in your browser. Nothing is stored or sent unless you choose to send them.

questions.question: Does any of the following apply to your company or product?
questions.help:
- Mass surveillance or identification of individuals without a lawful basis is core to the product
- The product is designed to manipulate behaviour, opinions or elections, including deepfakes or disinformation at scale
- Weapons-related applications or offensive cyber tooling
- Practices prohibited under the EU AI Act
- Owners, key persons or funding sources that cannot be identified, or that appear on sanctions lists

options.label: No, none of these
Not sure. One of them may apply
options.note: One of Attolloo's red lines may apply. That has to be clarified before anything else.

options.label: Yes
options.note: Attolloo's red lines apply regardless of commercial attractiveness. They are set out in the Responsible AI commitments.

questions.question: Which sector does your company operate in?
questions.help: Attolloo works with AI companies entering regulated markets, whether they sell to the established players or compete with them.

options.label: Fintech, insurtech, regtech or compliance automation
Cybersecurity services or HR technology
Another regulated sector
options.note: Your sector is not on Attolloo's main list. Whether the experience carries over is a question for the first conversation.

options.label: Health or life science
options.note: Health and life science are outside what Attolloo takes on.

options.label: We compete in the pension market, or our main customers are pension providers or the public sector
options.note: Attolloo does not take on companies that compete in the pension market, or whose main customers are pension providers or the public sector.

options.label: A sector without significant regulation
options.note: Attolloo works with companies entering regulated markets.

questions.question: What do you sell, and to whom?

options.label: AI-driven software or services, sold to regulated businesses or institutions
An AI-driven service of our own in a regulated market, competing with the established players
Hardware without a software governance layer
options.note: Hardware without a software governance layer is outside what Attolloo takes on.

questions.question: What evidence do you have that customers will pay for it?

options.label: We have paying customers
We have paid pilots
We have signed letters of intent, but nobody is paying yet
options.note: Attolloo takes on companies with paying customers. With signed letters of intent you may be close. Say where the first contract stands.

options.label: We have no paying customers and no signed commitments yet
options.note: Companies without paying customers are outside what Attolloo takes on.

questions.question: Attolloo starts with a Readiness Assessment at a fixed price. Is a paid first step something you are open to?
questions.help: The price is quoted before the work starts. Equity only comes up later, and only in an executive partnership.

options.label: Yes
Possibly, depending on price and scope
options.note: The assessment has a fixed price, quoted before the work starts. Price and scope are part of the first conversation, which is free.

options.label: No, we are only looking for someone who works for equity
options.note: Attolloo starts with a paid assessment. Equity is only part of an executive partnership, and only after an assessment.

questions.question: Is the problem real, and can you show it with buying behaviour rather than market-size estimates?

options.label: Yes. Customers already buy, and we have the data to show it
We see clear demand signals, but the evidence is thin
So far we rely on market-size estimates

questions.question: Does each customer bring in substantially more than it costs to win them?

options.label: Yes. We track acquisition cost, payback time and long-term customer value
We believe so, but we do not track it systematically
We do not know yet

questions.question: Could your team and infrastructure deliver at several times today's volume?

options.label: Yes. We have mapped where the constraints are
For a while, but we know something will break
We have not looked at it

questions.question: Is your roadmap sequenced for capital efficiency, and does your business model generate the data it needs?

options.label: Yes. It is sequenced by what de-risks the next stage, and the data comes out of operations
The roadmap is clear, but data is collected as needed
The roadmap is mostly a list of features

questions.question: Have you assessed regulatory exposure, platform dependency and worst-case scenarios, and not only commercial risk?

options.label: Yes. It is documented and reviewed
We know the main risks, but they are not written down
We have focused on the upside

questions.question: Does your leadership make structured decisions under uncertainty, with clear owners, documented reasoning and a working board?

options.label: Yes. Governance is in place and used
Decisions get made, but informally
Decisions are mostly made as issues come up

strong.heading: This looks like a match
strong.body: You are in a sector Attolloo works in, and you report evidence on all six dimensions. The next step is a Readiness Assessment, where that evidence is tested and you get a written report and a 90-day plan.

possible.heading: Possibly a match, with gaps to talk through
possible.body: The fit is there, but your answers show gaps or open questions. That is common at this stage, and closing governance gaps is the work Attolloo does. A Readiness Assessment puts those gaps in priority order. Bring them to the first conversation.

not_yet.heading: Probably not a match yet
not_yet.body: Several of the six dimensions are not in place yet. The 6Sense Filter requires all six, so a screening now would most likely end in a no. The dimensions marked "Not yet" below are where to start.

veto.heading: Not a match yet: decision-making comes first
veto.body: In the 6Sense Filter, the Decision dimension holds a veto. A company that cannot make structured decisions under uncertainty fails the filter regardless of the other five. Get clear owners, documented reasoning and a working board in place, then take the test again.

excluded.heading: Not a match for Attolloo
excluded.body: At least one of your answers falls outside what Attolloo takes on. That says nothing about the quality of your company. It means Attolloo is the wrong tool for it.

scoring_note:
Any of the five fit questions can rule a match out. Each of the six dimensions is then rated documented, partly or not yet, based on your answer. No dimension at "not yet", at least three documented and a clear fit reads as a match. Decision at "not yet" is a veto. Up to two dimensions at "not yet" reads as possibly a match, and three or more as not yet.

This is a self-assessment. A Readiness Assessment tests the evidence behind each answer.
